title: Indirect Prompt Injection in Autonomous Agent Tool Execution
description: Adversarial prompt injection embedded in untrusted Markdown, web page bodies, and pull requests manipulates autonomous coding agents into executing arbitrary system commands via tool closures.

title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Insecure Python REPL in LLM Frameworks
description: Unsanitized LLM-generated code passed directly to PythonAstREPLTool or exec() leads to remote code execution and host environment compromise.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Configuration and Tool Manifest Poisoning
description: Malicious repositories plant poisoned mcp.json or .cursorrules configuration files directing local MCP clients to spawn rogue subprocesses with elevated privileges.

title: Training Data Extraction via Adversarial Suffixes
description: Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) adversarial suffix optimization induces aligned foundation models to bypass safety alignments and regurgitate copyrighted or private training data.

title: Blind Database Extraction via Text-to-SQL Agent Injection
description: Attacker crafts inputs causing the text-to-SQL translator to generate union-based queries exfiltrating credential tables and system catalog metadata.

title: Steganographic Cross-Domain Context Hijacking via Exif and Invisible Unicode
description: Adversarial prompts concealed within image metadata, zero-width spaces, or homoglyphs bypass input DLP filters and hijack downstream LLM context windows.

title: Unsafe Deserialization of Untrusted Machine Learning Model Checkpoints
description: Deserialization of PyTorch .pth, pickle, or corrupted GGUF/Safetensors headers triggers arbitrary opcode evaluation during model weight instantiation.
